title: What to do next
notice: Check the latest rules on the official Election Commission or your state CEO website.

steps.title: Check your name
steps.text: Search electoralsearch.eci.gov.in, use the Voter Helpline App, or call 1950.

steps.title: Apply with Form 6 if your name is missing
steps.text: Apply online at voters.eci.gov.in or in the Voter Helpline App.

steps.title: Apply offline
steps.text: Collect Form 6 from your BLO or the Electoral Registration Officer (ERO/AERO) office.

steps.title: Check which documents are needed
steps.text: When applying online, upload supporting documents with Form 6. The documents depend on your case, so confirm with your BLO or the official site.

steps.title: Track your application
steps.text: Save your reference number after you submit. Track your application at voters.eci.gov.in or in the Voter Helpline App. Applying is free.

steps.title: Related forms
steps.text: Form 7 is used to object to or ask for deletion of an entry, such as a multiple entry. Form 8 is for corrections and change of residence. Ask your BLO which form fits your case.

steps.title: Accessibility support
steps.text: People with disabilities can use the Saksham app from the Election Commission.

documents.text: When applying online, upload supporting documents with Form 6. The documents depend on your case, so confirm with your BLO or the official site.

deadlines.text: Check the deadline on your state CEO website.
